text: Supervised learning models learn mapping functions from input features X to target labels Y using algorithms like Random Forests and XGBoost.
Convolutional Neural Networks process grid images using Conv2D filters, max pooling, batch normalization, and residual blocks.
RL agents select actions in environments to maximize cumulative rewards using Dueling Double DQN or Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO).
RAG systems retrieve top-k semantic context chunks from a vector store to ground LLM generation and generate exact source citations.
